mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing tamoxifen metabolism and increasing its active metabolite (endoxifen) levels, while tamoxifen has weak serotonergic activity that may potentiate MAOI effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, use alternative antidepressant and monitor closely for serotonergic symptoms, QT prolongation, and tamoxifen toxicity.
